description: This file defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceDao class, which manages database operations related to employee work experience records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee work experience data, and uses Doctrine ORM queries.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling employee work experience records, providing methods to save, retrieve, delete, and search records within the database context.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Saves an employee work experience record, assigning a sequence number if not set, and validates the sequence number before persisting.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkExperienceById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee work experience record based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingEmpWorkExperienceIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns a list of sequence numbers for given employee ID that exist in the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeWorkExperiences
methods.description: Deletes multiple employee work experience records identified by their sequence numbers for a specific employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Performs a search for employee work experiences based on provided filter parameters, returning matching records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencePaginator
methods.description: Creates and configures a paginator object for searching employee work experiences with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencesCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of employee work experience records matching the search filter.
